tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App and page ground. Paper by day, night ink by night.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Editor panes, cards, dialogs, chart plot areas. One step lifted from bg.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Toolbars, file headers, hunk bars, hover rows. Body text on wash uses ink or ink-muted only.

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: Warm highlight from the poster frames: search hits, the current line, a selected table row. Never a text colour.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, 1px rules, solid buttons. 11.6:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, axis labels, legend text. 4.5:1+ on bg, surface and wash.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-text only: disabled glyphs, tick marks, placeholder carets. Below 4.5:1, so never body text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside a pane. Pane edges use ink.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Indigo, from the first poster’s hand. Links, selected tab underline, focus ring, live state, branch chips, code keywords.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows and the ground under accent-coloured callouts.

tokens.name: salsa
tokens.usage: The poster lettering. Display headings 24px+, needs-you squares, inbox counts. 3.5:1 on paper: never small text.

tokens.name: salsa-deep
tokens.usage: Small red text (waiting on you, danger labels) and the danger button fill.

tokens.name: chile
tokens.usage: Deleted lines: marker, line number, −count. Failing checks.

tokens.name: chile-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a deleted diff line.

tokens.name: chile-gutter
tokens.usage: Line-number gutter of a deleted diff line.

tokens.name: cilantro
tokens.usage: Added lines: marker, line number, +count. Passing checks.

tokens.name: cilantro-tint
tokens.usage: Background of an added diff line.

tokens.name: cilantro-gutter
tokens.usage: Line-number gutter of an added diff line.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Warning state (pending checks, stale branch). Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: cat-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 · indigo. Categorical order is fixed: cat-1 → cat-5, never cycled.

tokens.name: cat-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 · salsa.

tokens.name: cat-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 · jade (a brighter cilantro, so it separates from salsa for red-green colourblind readers).

tokens.name: cat-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 · ochre, from the frames.

tokens.name: cat-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 · plum. A sixth series folds into Other or small multiples.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential indigo ramp, lowest. Heatmaps and choropleths: low → high = seq-1 → seq-5.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential step 2.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential step 3.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential step 4.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential step 5, highest.

tokens.name: div-neg
tokens.usage: Diverging, strong negative pole (salsa). Removed, slower, worse.

tokens.name: div-neg-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, mild negative.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging midpoint: a neutral, never a hue.

tokens.name: div-pos-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, mild positive.

tokens.name: div-pos
tokens.usage: Diverging, strong positive pole (indigo). Added, faster, better.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and the zero baseline’s neighbours. Recessive by design.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Axis labels and tick text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, 1px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page at most: the name on a cover, a landing hero. Usually salsa.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Pane titles, the worktree name, chart titles.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Hero numbers in stat tiles. Tabular figures.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: List-row titles, dialog titles, button-sized emphasis.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Fan-out happens inside the publish statement.
styles.usage: Running text, comments, descriptions. Keep lines under ~72 characters.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Diffs, terminals, inline code. Ligatures off.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata under a title, chart tooltips, captions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and tabs, usually in brackets: [ LABEL ] count.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in lists and tables.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Pane padding, the minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a pane.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between chart cards, page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty states and covers.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for everything: panes, buttons, inputs, badges, cards. Barrio is square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Chart data-ends (bar tops) and kbd keys only.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Chart line markers and the crosshair dot. Nothing in the UI chrome.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: the command palette, menus, dialogs, chart tooltips. Panes never cast shadows.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Every border and divider.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: Chart lines, the active-tab underline, focus rings.

tokens.name: stroke-gap
tokens.usage: Surface-coloured gap between adjacent bars and stacked segments.
